1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the second alarm is independent of and distinct from the first alarm, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is distinguishable from the first alarm.

16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation states of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and escalation state information; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data including the escalation state information.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices when the alarm reaches a predetermined escalation level.
